comment: I don't love stats, but Dr. Lowder made it enjoyable! He genuinely cares about his students and their success. His tests were fair, and it was clear what was expected of us. He would ask for feedback and change accordingly to make the class the best it could be. A lot of other classes use things we learn, so having a good teacher is super important
I love Dr. Lowder! His 299 cogsci class is really fun and engaging and he makes sure that lectures are well understood. Exams are a bit on the harder side, but otherwise he is great!

Dr. Lowder is the best!!! He explains everything very clearly, both coursework and his expectations. Not a ton of work outside of class and exams were very easy as long as you took notes. Very kind and clearly cares about his students. Take Dr. Lowder!!!

Dr. Lowder is my favorite professor I've ever had. This class was made so much easier because of him. He is very clear with all his assignments and upcoming evaluations. His tests are fair and he gives great study guides. The homework is graded on completion. He is available outside of class and so so caring.

Dr. Lowder is probably the best professor I've ever had. His lectures are easy to follow and he makes it clear he wants the class to stop him and ask questions if he's going too fast or if we are confused. Not much homework at all.  Exams were very straight forward. He is an all around super nice guy and is super passionate about what he teaches.

One of my favorite professors I have had! Dr.Lowder cares so much about his students and is always there to help inside or outside of class. His exams can be tricky but he is very straightforward about his expectations and there are no surprises. Made stats easy for someone who has no background in the subject. Love Love Love this man.
An absolutely amazing professor. Had him for psych 100 and absolutely loved the class. He was engaging and genuinely seemed to care about his students. Would definitely take one of his classes again

Dr. Lowder is awesome! His lectures are engaging and clear, the homework is interesting and useful, and the tests are not very hard (but they have a lot of content). He truly cares about the students and does his best to help everyone succeed.

Dr. Lowder is a phenomenal teacher. PSYC 100 is a lecture with over 100 students, but he managed to learn every student's name in the first two weeks (and remembered them after a several week time off as the class is taught by multiple profs). He is passionate, understanding, and interactive, best lectures I've had.

Relies on PowerPoints to lecture in class but if you do the assigned readings, participate in class and stay some what engaged you can finish with a good grade and enjoy the class. Workload isn't heavy at all and he's very understanding.

He basically just reads off of the powerpoints in class. Attendance is important/mandatory. Lab was pointless for the most part. Homework is completion. 2 tests and a final were kind of tricky, not horrible. He is a nice dude but not the best at explaining things. If you know basic stats and can teach yourself you will be fine.

Dr. Lowder is an amazing professor! He makes difficult content much easier through thorough explanation of the content. He really cares about each student and will adjust his instruction if it doesn't seem to be working. There were three tests throughout the semester, but he also gave smaller assignments so each test didn't have as much weight.
